interpretation: No detectable general integration cost in this bounded matrix: next/legacy geometric mean is 0.9985 for smoke and 0.9983 for scaling, with overlapping ranges in all 34 pairs. All 214 paired command outputs, including references and warmups, agree exactly on emitted coefficients and samples.
limitations: Small and medium local cases; no claim about large SCC workloads or all possible high-core-count configurations.
Within-engine scaling still worsens above the useful parallelism of some cells; that behavior occurs in both engines.
The typical-model timing matrix does not isolate the cost of each corrected defect. No beyond-noise integration regression was observed in these cells.
The earlier smoke pilot had a dirty generated manifest and is excluded. All four qualified campaigns were clean.
No heavy local build or coverage work overlapped formal timings. Read-only CI status/log queries overlapped part of the final legacy campaign.
platform: macOS arm64, Mac Studio 24 cores (16 performance), Stata/MP 8-processor license

protocol.noise_rule: Compare five-run observed ranges and median absolute deviations. A disjoint range triggers investigation; overlap is not statistical proof of equality.

scope: M1 Mac smoke and bounded OLS/PPML scaling; correctness integration, no routing or parallel implementation changes.
